purpose: technical reference consistency for exact identifier joins; not a clinical benchmark of therapeutic efficacy
source_review_status: official source anchors identified; independent adjudication and live recertification outstanding

expected_links.basis: FDA KALYDECO labeling indicates ivacaftor CFTR potentiation for genetically eligible cystic fibrosis, not all CFTR genotypes

negative_controls.basis: Synthetic unrelated triple; should never be emitted merely due to name similarity or co-occurrence. Not a claim of absent or ineffective biology.

methodology.sampling: single annotated positive case, one synthetic negative control
methodology.measurements: exact triple precision and disallowed-link rejection
methodology.missing: independent domain reviewers, blinded additional diseases, specificity and sensitivity estimates, current live source snapshot, patient-outcome validation
methodology.warning: This file does NOT assert independent review completed, validated efficacy, or that all drugs/targets are represented.
